sentences.en: He lost the greater part of his fortune in speculation.
sentences.zh: 他在投机活动中损失了大部分财产。

sentences.en: That's just idle speculation. We don't know what really happened.
sentences.zh: 这只是无稽之谈。我们不知道到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: He consumed much of each day in idle speculation.
sentences.zh: 他每天花了很多时间空想。

senses.zh: 思考，思索 - 推断，推测；猜测 - 投机活动 - 投机买卖，投机生意
